limitations: No runtime or browser validation performed.
Temporary family sheets preserve ordered frames but display reduced thumbnails; review establishes static family-level evidence, not pixel-by-pixel inspection of every source pixel.
Confirmed outfit/identity discontinuities remain correction_required; all unresolved rows retain concrete gaps or ambiguity.
Top/left/right alpha contact is retained as unresolved because static evidence does not distinguish intentional pose/effect extent from cropping.
Bottom-only opaque contact is treated as expected only when per-file metadata axisY is within 1px of the 400px baseline; top/left/right touches and bottom/axis disagreements remain unresolved.
NPC Spitfire idle resolves to shared Akio art; its temporary anchor proxy is not an approved NPC-specific canonical anchor.
Procedural FX frames without resolved fighter PNGs remain unresolved.
